# Workplace

> Workplace is an AI-powered platform that measures organizational culture in real-time using natural language processing and cultural intelligence analytics.

Workplace helps HR leaders and organizations quantify, understand, and improve workplace culture through AI-driven insights. The platform integrates with tools like Slack and Microsoft Teams to provide continuous culture measurement and actionable intelligence for building psychological safety and organizational trust.
